name: Mizore Amane Wants to be an Unremarkable Wage Slave!
source:
Just two girls chatting! About the future, about drug dealing students attending their school, but never about themselves! (Something that'll DEFINITELY get worse when they're older...).

[Edited from [url=https://shinitai-tan.itch.io/mizore-amane]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
不過是兩個女孩在閒聊！聊未來，聊她們學校裡販毒的學生，就是從來不聊她們自己！（等年紀大了，這事肯定還會越來越糟……）
